summary: Full-stack engineer with 8+ years of experience building and scaling cloud-native applications. Specializes in React, Node.js, and distributed systems, with strong expertise in API design, microservices, and cloud platforms (AWS & GCP). Proven track record delivering production SaaS products and improving system scalability and reliability.

careers.title: Software Engineer
descriptions: Architected and scaled an AI-powered scheduling assistant SaaS as a full-stack engineer, delivering intelligent availability recommendations for end users at scale.
Designed and implemented high-performance RESTful APIs using Node.js and PostgreSQL, supporting core scheduling workflows and real-time data processing.
Deployed and operated cloud-native services on GCP and Firebase, ensuring system reliability and scalability.
Built and optimized a React-based web application, enabling users to manage and visualize personalized scheduling insights.
Integrated external calendar systems (Google & Outlook APIs) to aggregate and analyze cross-platform availability data.
Implemented asynchronous processing pipelines (pub/sub architecture) to improve system resilience and throughput.
Containerized and modularized services using Docker, transitioning toward a microservices architecture.

careers.title: Software Engineer
descriptions: Built and scaled the Radio.com Alexa Skill, supporting 1M+ active users across 300+ radio stations.
Engineered scalable backend services using Node.js, DynamoDB, and the Alexa SDK for high-availability voice interactions.
Designed serverless workflows using AWS Lambda, automating daily catalog updates via internal APIs.
Partnered with AWS engineers to test and deliver beta Alexa platform features.

careers.title: Agile Software Engineer
descriptions: Delivered full-stack solutions across 5+ client projects, spanning web and IoT applications in agile environments.
Designed RESTful APIs using Node.js/Express and PostgreSQL, enabling scalable multi-platform integrations.
Applied Test-Driven Development (TDD) to improve code reliability and maintainability across projects.
Implemented secure authentication systems using AWS Cognito.

careers.title: Front-End Developer
descriptions: Developed and enhanced a financial web platform using React, Ruby on Rails, and jQuery.
Built and optimized a high-converting marketing website, improving SEO and driving lead generation (MQLs).
Integrated Salesforce and Pardot, streamlining marketing-to-sales data flow and automation.

careers.title: Web Application Developer
descriptions: Built web application platforms from the ground up, contributing across both frontend and backend systems.
Led frontend development for 50+ pages using Angular, JSP, and SASS, ensuring responsive and cross-browser compatibility.
Collaborated on backend services using Spring and MySQL to support application logic and data processing.
